name: spellkave_remove_entity
label: Remove Entity
description: Remove a placed entity and its dependent instance rows from the active local root file, and clean matching staged scratch rows so a later flush cannot recreate it. Requires a local target; live targets are refused. Root headers, definitions and unrelated rows remain. Include-owned rows and surviving containment/ownership references are refused with recovery guidance before writes. Reports removed row counts. Does not change the running world: use diff/apply with prune separately.

entity_key.description: Exact authored key of the placed entity to remove from the local root and staged scratch, e.g. my_adventure/torch. This edits files only; preview and apply world pruning separately.
